explication: CC Pocket is a mobile and desktop client for Codex and Claude, with a self-hosted Bridge Server on the machine that owns the projects and agent CLIs. The main workflow is to connect the app to the Bridge, choose a project and agent, send prompts and handle approvals, then inspect or ship the resulting changes. The README also documents cross-device resume, offline message recovery, media, file/Git review, worktrees, and remote connectivity. Several app capabilities are documented but their Dart implementation is absent from the supplied tree; those links are shown as documented relationships, not inspected call paths.
